total.definition: CREATE TRIGGER total AFTER UPDATE OF total ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION total()

amount.definition: CREATE TRIGGER amount AFTER UPDATE OF amount ON orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION amount()

chain.definition: CREATE TRIGGER chain AFTER INSERT ON chain_start FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION chain()

total.definition: CREATE FUNCTION total() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.id; RETURN NEW; END; $$

amount.definition: CREATE FUNCTION amount() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE wrong_accounts SET latest = NEW.id WHERE id = NEW.id; RETURN NEW; END; $$

chain.definition: CREATE FUNCTION chain() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE orders SET total.amount = 1 WHERE id = NEW.id; RETURN NEW; END; $$
